briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Tops $17B in Weed Sales as National Rescheduling and Psychedelic Wins Stack Up
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis market just crossed a historic $17 billion in lifetime sales and a gubernatorial front-runner is now campaigning on killing the 24% wholesale tax — real signs the pain point has a political off-ramp. Nationally, Compass Pathways just cleared its second Phase 3 hurdle for psilocybin, DEA rescheduling cleared another procedural checkpoint, and MSOs are consolidating at scale, all pointing toward a friendlier federal landscape ahead.
